segments.source: An object that provides the interface to control the player’s transport behavior.
segments.ko: 플레이어의 재생 제어 동작을 관리하는 인터페이스를 제공하는 객체입니다.

segments.source: A player is a controller object that manages the playback and timing of a media asset.
segments.ko: 플레이어는 미디어 에셋의 재생과 타이밍을 관리하는 컨트롤러 객체입니다.

segments.source: Use an instance of [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) to play local and remote file-based media, such as QuickTime movies and MP3 audio files, as well as audiovisual media served using HTTP Live Streaming.
segments.ko: [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) 인스턴스를 사용해 QuickTime 영화 및 MP3 오디오 파일과 같은 로컬/원격 파일 기반 미디어와 HTTP Live Streaming을 통해 제공되는 오디오/비디오 미디어를 재생할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Use a player object to play a single media asset.
segments.ko: 단일 미디어 에셋을 재생하려면 플레이어 객체를 사용합니다.

segments.source: You can reuse the player instance to play additional media assets using its [`replaceCurrentItem(with:)`](avplayer/replacecurrentitem(with:).md) method, but it manages the playback of only a single media asset at a time.
segments.ko: [`replaceCurrentItem(with:)`](avplayer/replacecurrentitem(with:).md) 메서드를 사용해 플레이어 인스턴스를 재사용해 추가 미디어 에셋을 재생할 수 있지만, 한 번에 단일 미디어 에셋의 재생만 관리합니다.

segments.source: The framework also provides a subclass called [`AVQueuePlayer`](avqueueplayer.md) that you can use to manage the playback of a queue of media assets.
segments.ko: 또한 프레임워크에서는 미디어 에셋 큐의 재생을 관리할 수 있는 하위 클래스인 [`AVQueuePlayer`](avqueueplayer.md)를 제공합니다.

segments.source: You use an [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) to play media assets, which AVFoundation represents using the [`AVAsset`](avasset.md) class.
segments.ko: 미디어 에셋을 재생하려면 [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md)를 사용하며, AVFoundation은 이를 [`AVAsset`](avasset.md) 클래스로 표현합니다.

segments.source: [`AVAsset`](avasset.md) only models the *static* aspects of the media, such as its duration or creation date, and on its own, isn’t suitable for playback with an [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md).
segments.ko: [`AVAsset`](avasset.md)는 미디어의 기간이나 생성일 같은 *정적* 측면만 모델링하므로, 단독으로는 [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md)로 재생하기에 적합하지 않습니다.

segments.source: To play an asset, you create an instance of its *dynamic* counterpart found in [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md).
segments.ko: 에셋을 재생하려면 [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md)에 정의된 해당 동적 대응 항목의 인스턴스를 생성해야 합니다.

segments.source: This object models the timing and presentation state of an asset played by an instance of [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md).
segments.ko: This object models the timing and presentation state of an asset played by an instance of [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md).

segments.source: See the [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md) reference for more details.
segments.ko: See the [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md) reference for more details.

segments.source: [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) is a dynamic object whose state continuously changes.
segments.ko: [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) is a dynamic object whose state continuously changes.

segments.source: There are two approaches you can use to observe a player’s state:
segments.ko: There are two approaches you can use to observe a player’s state:

segments.source: **General State Observations:** You can use key-value observing (KVO) to observe state changes to many of the player’s dynamic properties, such as its [`currentItem`](avplayer/currentitem.md) or its playback [`rate`](avplayer/rate.md).
segments.ko: **General State Observations:** You can use key-value observing (KVO) to observe state changes to many of the player’s dynamic properties, such as its [`currentItem`](avplayer/currentitem.md) or its playback [`rate`](avplayer/rate.md).

segments.source: **Timed State Observations:** KVO works well for general state observations, but isn’t intended for observing continuously changing state like the player’s time. [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) provides two methods to observe time changes:
segments.ko: **Timed State Observations:** KVO works well for general state observations, but isn’t intended for observing continuously changing state like the player’s time. [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) provides two methods to observe time changes:

segments.source: These methods let you observe time changes either periodically or by boundary, respectively.
segments.ko: These methods let you observe time changes either periodically or by boundary, respectively.

segments.source: As changes occur, invoke the callback block or closure you supply to these methods to give you the opportunity to take some action such as updating the state of your player’s user interface.
segments.ko: As changes occur, invoke the callback block or closure you supply to these methods to give you the opportunity to take some action such as updating the state of your player’s user interface.

segments.source: [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) and [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md) are nonvisual objects, meaning that on their own they’re unable to present an asset’s video onscreen.
segments.ko: [`AVPlayer`](avplayer.md) and [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md) are nonvisual objects, meaning that on their own they’re unable to present an asset’s video onscreen.

segments.source: There are two primary approaches you use to present your video content onscreen:
segments.ko: There are two primary approaches you use to present your video content onscreen:

segments.source: **AVKit:** The best way to present your video content is with the AVKit framework’s [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController) class in iOS and tvOS, or the [`AVPlayerView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerView) class in macOS. These classes present the video content, along with playback controls and other media features giving you a full-featured playback experience.
segments.ko: **AVKit:** The best way to present your video content is with the AVKit framework’s [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController) class in iOS and tvOS, or the [`AVPlayerView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerView) class in macOS. These classes present the video content, along with playback controls and other media features giving you a full-featured playback experience.

segments.source: **AVPlayerLayer:** When building a custom interface for your player, use [`AVPlayerLayer`](avplayerlayer.md). You can set this layer a view’s backing layer or add it directly to the layer hierarchy. Unlike [`AVPlayerView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerView) and [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController), a player layer doesn’t present any playback controls—it only presents the visual content onscreen. It’s up to you to build the playback transport controls to play, pause, and seek through the media.
segments.ko: **AVPlayerLayer:** When building a custom interface for your player, use [`AVPlayerLayer`](avplayerlayer.md). You can set this layer a view’s backing layer or add it directly to the layer hierarchy. Unlike [`AVPlayerView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerView) and [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController), a player layer doesn’t present any playback controls—it only presents the visual content onscreen. It’s up to you to build the playback transport controls to play, pause, and seek through the media.

segments.source: Alongside the visual content presented with AVKit or [`AVPlayerLayer`](avplayerlayer.md), you can also present animated content synchronized with the player’s timing using [`AVSynchronizedLayer`](avsynchronizedlayer.md).
segments.ko: Alongside the visual content presented with AVKit or [`AVPlayerLayer`](avplayerlayer.md), you can also present animated content synchronized with the player’s timing using [`AVSynchronizedLayer`](avsynchronizedlayer.md).

segments.source: Use a synchronized layer pass along player timing to its layer subtree.
segments.ko: Use a synchronized layer pass along player timing to its layer subtree.

segments.source: You can use [`AVSynchronizedLayer`](avsynchronizedlayer.md) to build custom effects in Core Animation, such as animated lower thirds or video transitions, and have them play in sync with the timing of the player’s current [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md).
segments.ko: You can use [`AVSynchronizedLayer`](avsynchronizedlayer.md) to build custom effects in Core Animation, such as animated lower thirds or video transitions, and have them play in sync with the timing of the player’s current [`AVPlayerItem`](avplayeritem.md).
